mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate rises by more than 0.25% over the next month, higher discount rates reduce the present value of expected corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the following 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the trigger period (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS change is ≤ 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in PAYEMS (labor market tightness) above 152,000 monthly suggests strong labor demand, which typically precedes equity risk-on sentiment and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite PAYEMS exceeding 152,000 for the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in HOUST (residential construction) by at least 10% indicates weakening demand, which is associated with a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < previous month's value - 10% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive or not significantly different from zero (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly drop in INDPRO (industrial production index) below 110 suggests supply-side weakness, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during the trigger window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE (unemployment rate) falls by more than 0.2 percentage points in a month, it signals labor market strengthening and typically precedes equity risk-on flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDPC1 (GDP) and RSAFS (retail sales) above their 2023 Q2 averages for three months indicate robust demand, which is expected to drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 2023Q2_GDP and RSAFS > 2023Q2_RSAFS for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of falling UNRATE below 3.2% for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 is expected to exhibit positive forward returns over the next 20 days due to improved market sentiment about labor market resilience.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite UNRATE below 3.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in CPIAUCSL (CPI) by 0.5% or more indicates accelerating inflation, which typically precedes a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days as market anticipates rate hikes.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < previous month's value - 0.5% for two months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.1).
